title: WebSec Shared Capability Signature
description: A DERIVED capability signature of a CONFIRMED finding or materialized chain, published to the cross-campaign shared store so a later campaign on the same program can recognize the primitive. Deliberately capability-level only: no finding text, evidence, economic impact, or cost data ever crosses into the shared store — the source pointer lets the operator open the origin campaign if they want the full record.

program_key.description: normalized program|platform|chains key — the recall filter

scope.description: visibility rule: 'program' (the default when absent) recalls only for the matching program key; 'global' recalls for EVERY campaign. Changed only via set_scope / `webv2 globalize`, which logs a manifest record.

code_sourced_required.description: the subset of `required` that some finding in the primitive's campaign grants — i.e. capabilities the code is (or was) the source of. Only these can legitimately be 'missing' after a patch; required caps no finding grants are attacker-held (exogenous) and their absence is not a patch signal. Computed at publish time, since the primitive's campaign is the only place that knowledge exists.

terminal.description: the economic terminal capability this primitive reaches, or null

capability_signature.description: order-invariant hash over program_key + granted + required + terminal; the idempotency key

title.description: the ONE human-readable field carried across; evidence/PoC/impact stay in the origin campaign
